# JavaScript Language Analysis

This file implements an analyzer for JavaScript source files, extracting structured facts about components, symbols, dependencies, API endpoints, and tests. It operates deterministically over .js, .jsx, .mjs, and .cjs files, using a tree-sitter-backed parser to traverse syntax trees, capturing both ESM and CommonJS dependencies, Express/Fastify routes, and test cases conforming to common NodeJS patterns.
